QuestInfo.name: [Commerci Republic] Delfino Deleter 1
QuestInfo.0: You decided to help stop the Delfinos. Leon went off to fight them, and you convinced Gilberto to allow you to help.
QuestInfo.1: Leon went off to fight the Delfinos, and you followed after him. Together, you and Leon encountered your first group of Delfinos.
QuestInfo.2: You decided to help Leon stop the Delfinos. The first group was defeated easily, and Leon took off in pursuit of more.

0.0: Delfinos don't like to get caught in a big fight. They roam the canals in small groups, but they can disappear in an instant.

yes.0: I'll head that way. See you in the #b#m865020000##k.

no.0: Let me know when you're ready to hunt some fish.

1.0: It's my first time fighting the Delfinos, and they're weaker than I thought.
1.1: Why did it take so long to defeat these weak monsters? To be fair, they would raid at night in small numbers and catch people by surprise.

yes.0: Is it just me, or was that way too easy?
